tools.name: create_shortlink
tools.description: Create a new shortlink. The shortlink path must start with 'my/' (personal) or 'yt/' (YouTube globals). Once created, my/ shortlinks resolve publicly at https://urlinks.me/{alias}/{name} (assuming the user has set an alias via create_alias) — that's the URL QR codes encode for click tracking. Group

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List all your shortlinks. Returns shortlink slugs, destination URLs, descriptions, and the public scan URL each one resolves at (e.g. urlinks.me/{alias}/foo). The public URL is what QR codes and shareable links use.

tools.name: search_links
tools.description: Search your shortlinks by name, URL, or description. Use this to find an existing link before creating a new one.

tools.name: get_link_analytics
tools.description: Get click analytics for a shortlink — total clicks, daily breakdown, and last clicked time.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete a shortlink permanently. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: edit_link
tools.description: Update a shortlink's destination URL or description.

tools.name: bulk_create_links
tools.description: Create multiple shortlinks at once (max 50). Use this when you need to create several links in one operation.

tools.name: save_qr_config
tools.description: Save a QR code style configuration for an existing shortlink. The generated QR encodes the urlinks.me redirect URL (https://urlinks.me/{alias}/{name} for my/ links, or https://urlinks.me/{shortlink} for yt/ and group links) — NOT the destination URL directly — so every scan is counted as a click. Pe

tools.name: list_qr_templates
tools.description: List the user's saved QR style templates — reusable styles (colors, shapes, center logo/emblem) they can apply to any link with apply_qr_template.

tools.name: apply_qr_template
tools.description: Apply a saved QR style template to a shortlink — copies the template's full style (colors, shapes, center logo/emblem) onto that link's QR. Reference the template by its name or id (see list_qr_templates).

tools.name: delete_qr_template
tools.description: Delete a saved QR style template by its name or id.

tools.name: get_qr_config
tools.description: Get the QR code configuration for a shortlink, including whether one has been set up.

tools.name: get_qr_image
tools.description: Generate a QR code image (SVG or PNG) for a shortlink. The QR encodes the urlinks.me redirect URL (NOT the bare destination) so scans count as clicks: my/foo → urlinks.me/{alias}/foo, yt/foo → urlinks.me/yt/foo. Personal (my/) shortlinks therefore require the user to have an alias set — call get_ali

tools.name: get_customization_rules
tools.description: Get the complete rule set for customizing a URLinks profile page via CSS. Returns the concern map (which CSS classes target which profile elements), the actual HTML structure each class wraps, example CSS for each concern, allowed properties, blocked patterns, and tips. Always call this FIRST before

tools.name: get_custom_css
tools.description: Get the user's current custom CSS for all profile concerns. Shows which concerns have active CSS and what CSS is applied to each.

tools.name: submit_custom_css
tools.description: Submit custom CSS for one or more profile concerns. The CSS is sanitized server-side and stored per-concern. Call get_customization_rules first to understand what selectors and properties are available. CSS must target .pc-* classes only. url() is blocked — use gradients and solid colors. @keyframes

tools.name: reset_custom_css
tools.description: Reset/remove custom CSS for specific concerns, or all concerns at once. This removes the custom styling and reverts to the default appearance.

tools.name: get_alias
tools.description: Check if the user has a username/alias set. An alias is required before a profile can be created — it becomes the public URL (urlinks.me/{alias}). Call this first when starting profile setup.

tools.name: create_alias
tools.description: Create a username/alias for the user. This is REQUIRED before any profile operations — the alias becomes the public URL (urlinks.me/{alias}). Rules: 5+ characters, alphanumeric only, must be unique.

tools.name: update_alias
tools.description: Change the user's alias/username to a new one. Their profile URL will change from urlinks.me/{old} to urlinks.me/{new}. The profile is automatically migrated.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get the user's current profile — display name, bio, blocks, social links, theme, custom CSS, and published status. Requires an alias to be set first (use get_alias to check, create_alias to set one).

tools.name: get_public_profile
tools.description: View any user's public profile by username. Returns the published profile as visitors see it.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update the profile's basic info — display name, bio, or avatar URL. Only the fields you provide will change; everything else stays the same. This does NOT publish the profile — use publish_profile for that.

tools.name: add_block
tools.description: Add a block to the profile. Blocks appear in order — new blocks are added at the end by default, or at a specific position. Block types: link (clickable button), header (section heading), text (paragraph), divider (visual separator), image (full-width image), embed (YouTube/Spotify/SoundCloud), spac

tools.name: remove_block
tools.description: Remove a block from the profile by its position (0-based index). Use get_profile first to see the block list and positions.

tools.name: reorder_blocks
tools.description: Move a block from one position to another. Use get_profile to see current positions first.

tools.name: add_social_link
tools.description: Add a social link to the profile's social icon bar. Common platforms: twitter, instagram, github, linkedin, youtube, tiktok, facebook, twitch, discord, spotify, email, website.

tools.name: remove_social_link
tools.description: Remove a social link by platform name.

tools.name: set_theme
tools.description: Apply a visual theme preset. Uses @urlinks/profile-presets (paper, aurora, galaxy, …). Legacy names (clean, cream, dark, …) are aliases. Prefer apply_theme for the same behavior. You can also set custom colors as overrides.

tools.name: publish_profile
tools.description: Publish or unpublish the profile. A published profile is visible at urlinks.me/{username}. An unpublished profile is a draft — only the owner can see it in the editor.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List theme presets. Prefer list_themes_v2 for the full canonical catalog. Use set_theme or apply_theme to apply one.

tools.name: get_profile_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for the user's profile — total views, per-link click counts, and daily breakdowns. Shows which links are getting the most engagement.

tools.name: list_profile_style_options
tools.description: Catalog of profile style options — fonts, scenes, gradients, animations, block types, embed providers.

tools.name: update_page_style
tools.description: Merge visual/layout fields into page_style. Syncs displayName/bio/avatarUrl to top-level profile when set.

tools.name: update_block
tools.description: Update block content/style by position or block_id.

tools.name: add_block_v2
tools.description: Add a block with full prototype parity (gallery, countdown, product, embed presets).

tools.name: apply_theme
tools.description: Apply a canonical theme preset (paper, aurora, galaxy, …). Legacy names are aliases.

tools.name: list_themes_v2
tools.description: List canonical theme presets (editor prototype).

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "save_qr_config" is 806 chars, far longer than this server's median (136). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_links, search_links, save_qr_config, get_qr_image, get_customization_rules, get_alias · Public sink: submit_custom_css, update_profile, add_social_link, publish_profile · Destructive: delete_link, save_qr_config, delete_qr_template, reset_custom_css, remove_block, remove_social_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_links, search_links, save_qr_config, get_qr_image, get_customization_rules, get_alias · Public sink: submit_custom_css, update_profile, add_social_link, publish_profile · Destructive: delete_link, save_qr_config, delete_qr_template, reset_custom_css, remove_block, remove_social_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
